\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 222-224 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R227-first-pass-words-from-chapters-222-224}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for luggage and a place.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a soldier, a flag, religion, culture, a tradition
  \item a poem, a painting, a writer, a painter, a photographer
  \item an adult, an elderly person, a newborn, a twin, a grandson
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A soldier? (\textbf{il soldato}.) A flag? (\textbf{la bandiera}.) Religion? (\textbf{la religione}.) Culture? (\textbf{la cultura}.) A tradition? (\textbf{la tradizione}.) A poem? (\textbf{la poesia}.) A painting? (\textbf{il quadro}.) A writer? (\textbf{lo scrittore}.) A painter? (\textbf{il pittore}.) A photographer? (\textbf{il fotografo}.) An adult? (\textbf{l'adulto}.) An elderly person? (\textbf{l'anziano}.) A newborn? (\textbf{il neonato}.) A twin? (\textbf{il gemello}.) A grandson? (\textbf{il nipote}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

A till receipt? (\textbf{lo scontrino}.) Change? (\textbf{il resto}.) A coin? (\textbf{la moneta}.) A banknote? (\textbf{la banconota}.) A cash machine? (\textbf{il bancomat}.) A guide?
